physics.provenance: synthetic pretraining geometry, NOT measured apparatus
assumptions: Constant outlet height and open/closed setting within each run; no refills or receiver drainage.
Primed water-filled hoses, quasi-steady lumped discharge q = k*sqrt(max(surface-outlet,0)).
k includes effective area, gravity and aggregate losses; not a universal hose constant.
No pump, siphon priming/air ingress, hose deformation, inertia, leakage or water hammer model.
Never substitute these dimensions for null measured geometry in hardware/rig.json.

limitations: 0D graph ODE-PINN, not a spatial Navier–Stokes/transient pipe PDE solver
Synthetic reference parameters until measured geometry/coefficient calibration
Fixed outlet height/mask during each prediction; no automatic valve control
F3 observes H2+H3 only; separate hose experiments needed for identification
